runtimeAndInstallPrerequisites.installation: Extract the entire ZIP to a local folder you control; run PixelBridge.exe with runtime scripts, Profiles, Assets, and text guides kept together.
runtimeAndInstallPrerequisites.cloud: Xbox Cloud uses a fresh dedicated Microsoft Edge profile. GeForce NOW supports its official web player or the user's selected official native app. Users provide accounts/subscriptions subject to provider requirements.
runtimeAndInstallPrerequisites.lan: Sunshine and Moonlight are separately installed/configured projects; Sunshine is not bundled. LAN use requires no router WAN port forwarding or UPnP.
runtimeAndInstallPrerequisites.hdmi: Supported PC HDMI output and TV input; guided native Windows display/audio settings, not automatic TV control. Controller stays paired directly to the PC.

productionCompatibilityEvidence.documentedChecks: Isolated source/schema/round-trip checks for native profiles and isolated license/edition checks; coordinator-reported package-content reviews.
productionCompatibilityEvidence.priorXboxStreaming: Success with the installed predecessor is not evidence of these new-feature acceptance results.
productionCompatibilityEvidence.limits: No zero-lag, FPS, cloud-latency reduction, universal hardware, HDMI-CEC, HDR, or display-mode guarantee.

documentedFeatureMatrix.feature: Xbox Cloud / GeForce NOW / LAN / guided direct HDMI
Manual executable/media launching and official project links
All five standard Xbox native .rmp remaps and common XInput .cfg bindings, with standard native import/export
Curated descriptions and saved launcher shortcuts
Static disclosed AdGuard affiliate banners on Emulators and Network only; no automatic banner network request, overlay, counter, or click gate
Advanced port-1 digital remap editing, saved per-system variants, and custom native subset import/export; analog axes unchanged

documentedNativeProfileTargets.limits: Reference profiles, not actual gameplay/controller certification. Standard native imports/exports are free. Standalone alternatives use their own input menus; RetroArch files are not claimed as their native imports.

productionBuildExcludesTestUnlocks.documentedBoundary: Customer package export excludes the separately compiled Local Test Pro build, test executables, receipts, previews, private source, user state, and customer entitlements. No production runtime test key or unlock switch.

privacyAndSupportFacts.licenseStorage: Minimal key/status is DPAPI-encrypted for the current Windows user; no raw purchase response, full PII, or customer key logging.
privacyAndSupportFacts.network: No analytics, startup task, tray daemon, or automatic banner network request. Explicit provider/download clicks, local health checks, and consented activation/weekly refresh contact their respective endpoints.
privacyAndSupportFacts.sunshineBoundary: No reading of host configuration, apps list, credentials, certificates, or pairing state. A local host response does not prove pairing/encoding/audio/game compatibility.
privacyAndSupportFacts.networkChanges: No required WAN forwarding/UPnP, automatic VPN changes, router configuration, or disabling of security tools. Optional Private-profile firewall action previews exact scope and asks consent/elevation; it does not open Sunshine administration.
privacyAndSupportFacts.closingApp: Stops its own polling, not Sunshine, a browser, or a game.
privacyAndSupportFacts.support: General studio support: /support/. Purchase help: route supplied by the customer's Gumroad receipt.

paidLicensePolicy.purchase: One-time purchase for Supporter and Pro
paidLicensePolicy.activation: Matching customer key from Gumroad receipt; fixed edition product ID and official HTTPS API, increment_uses_count=false. Failed first activation never grants access.
paidLicensePolicy.onlineRecheck: Weekly while the app is open or on later launch
paidLicensePolicy.offline: Previously verified one-time purchases remain usable indefinitely offline. Temporary network errors retain prior extras with stale/offline status.
paidLicensePolicy.confirmedInvalidation: Removes paid extras only, never games, standard mappings, media, or retained library/variant files.
paidLicensePolicy.acceptanceGap: No real customer-key/API activation acceptance test has been completed.

editions.licenseRequirements: Matching customer receipt key activates paid extras only; see paidLicensePolicy.

publicationRequirements: Receive the coordinator's validated final signed-release handoff. The user has already authorized publication after real signed releases; no additional generic publication-approval question is needed.
Confirm exact public artifacts, channel, sizes, checksums, matching Sigstore bundles, issuer, certificate identity, and executable verification commands against the actual signed release.

Carry forward the reviewed customer-doc facts: Windows 11 x64/.NET Framework 4.8; all-tier essential play, HDMI, every standard native mapping and import/export; Pro limited to advanced digital variants/custom native subset.

Preserve explicit untested acceptance gaps after release signing: real customer-key activation, new emulator/controller gameplay, HDMI/audio, and clean-PC Sunshine pairing. Do not substitute predecessor Xbox-streaming success for them.
Do not imply zero lag, measured latency/FPS gains, universal device support, automatic TV firmware control, or required WAN forwarding/UPnP.

Use only approved original branding and documented official project routes. No local browser profile, Sunshine configuration, credentials, customer data, games, ROMs, BIOS files, firmware, or keys may be copied.
Confirm every public build is production-only. Never publish an unlocked Pro test build, license bypass, customer key, or private source link.

Use the approved Supporter/Pro URLs with one-time purchase and See current price on Gumroad wording. Do not hardcode a price or invent a subscription/seat limit. Confirm exact production package delivery in the signed-release handoff.
